let b := Sup s
use b
· intro x
  intro hx
  have h1 : x ∈ s := hx
  have h2 : x ≤ b := le_Sup_iff.1 (mem_Sup h1)
  rw [le_antisymm_iff] at h2
  exact h2.1
· intro y
  intro hy
  have h1 : y ∈ t := hy
  have h2 : b ≤ y := le_Sup_iff.2 (mem_Sup h1)
  rw [le_antisymm_iff] at h2
  exact h2.2
